annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3002-14a Standard Specification for Design of the Command and Control System for Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS)
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3002-14a Standard Specification for Design of the Command and Control System for Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS)
annotation.summary_en: ASTM International store page for F3002-14a, a voluntary consensus specification for designing command and control (C2) systems of small unmanned aircraft (≤25 kg). It is meant to support applications to a national aviation authority for permits to operate sUAS for commercial or public use. It covers C2 link, spectrum and fly-away requirements.
key_provisions_or_claims: Consensus standard supporting sUAS operating-permit applications to a nation's governing aviation authority
Applies to unmanned aircraft with max gross takeoff weight of 25 kg (55 lb) or less unless GAA specifies otherwise
Covers general C2 requirements, C2 spectrum and link requirements, UA requirements and fly-away functionality
Users are responsible for establishing safety practices and checking applicable regulatory limits
